title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Get to know Okta**



Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

  



At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box, we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

  



Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

  


**The Engineering Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join Okta's Emerging Products Group (EPG). Our mission is to build highly reliable, scalable, and secure cloud services that our customers can trust. We embrace an automation\-first mindset and continuously invest in platform engineering, observability, and operational excellence to enable our engineering teams to move quickly and safely.



This role is ideal for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges at scale, building automation, and improving the reliability of production systems. You will serve as a key contributor within the EPG SRE organization, partnering closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, build, and operate world\-class cloud services.



The ideal candidate exemplifies the philosophy of "if you have to do it more than once, automate it" and possesses a strong passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and software engineering.


**What You'll Be Doing**
**Reliability \& Operations**
-----------------------------


* Design, build, and operate large\-scale cloud infrastructure and production services.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation supporting highly available customer\-facing systems.
* Lead incident response efforts and drive post\-incident reviews focused on systemic improvements.
* Define, measure, and improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve service availability, scalability, performance, and resilience.
* Continuously improve observability through metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.

**Engineering \& Automation**
-----------------------------


* Develop software, automation, and infrastructure using Go, Python, Terraform, and related technologies.
* Eliminate operational toil through automation, tooling, and platform engineering.
* Improve deployment safety and operational workflows through CI/CD and GitOps practices.
* Collaborate on modernizing existing workloads and aligning them with evolving platform capabilities.
* Build self\-service platforms, operational guardrails, and automation that improve developer velocity while maintaining reliability and security.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------


* Contribute to and drive reliability initiatives within the product group.
* Guide engineers in adopting operational best practices and reliability engineering principles.
* Mentor engineers through technical collaboration, design reviews, incident analysis, and knowledge sharing.
* Support architecture and operational decisions through data\-driven recommendations and engineering expertise.
* Execute projects from conception through production rollout and long\-term operational ownership.

**Innovation**
--------------


* Explore and apply AI\-assisted engineering techniques to improve operational efficiency, incident response, troubleshooting, and automation.
* Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to reduce toil and improve engineering productivity.

**Our Tech Stack**
------------------


* Infrastructure/Orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform, Helm, Git, ArgoCD, GitOps
* Programming: Golang, Python
* Observability: Datadog, Splunk
* Data Stores: PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch

  


**What We Are Looking For**


**Technical Excellence**
------------------------


* Strong experience operating large\-scale production services in AWS and/or GCP.
* Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production environments.
* Experience troubleshooting Kubernetes networking, storage, scheduling, scaling, and workload lifecycle issues.
* Extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform and Helm.
* Strong software engineering skills in Golang and/or Python.
* Experience building automation and internal engineering platforms.
* Experience operating and troubleshooting distributed data platforms such as PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenSearch, MySQL, Cassandra, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, ingress, TLS, service networking, and traffic management.
* Experience with observability platforms, monitoring strategies, and production telemetry.
* Experience with or strong interest in AI\-assisted engineering and operational automation.

**Operational Excellence**
--------------------------


* Strong expertise operating customer\-facing production systems.
* Experience leading incident response and driving operational improvements.
* Deep understanding of reliability engineering concepts including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and capacity planning.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and automation\-first operational practices.
* Proven ability to balance reliability, scalability, security, and engineering velocity.


**Security \& Compliance**
--------------------------


* Understanding of cloud security fundamentals, IAM, secrets management, and secure infrastructure design.
* Experience implementing operational controls and best practices in regulated or security\-sensitive environments is a plus.

**Leadership**
--------------


* Demonstrated experience contributing to complex engineering initiatives.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Experience working effectively within globally distributed engineering organizations spanning multiple timezones and cultures.
* Experience mentoring engineers and elevating technical capabilities within an organization.
* Ability to collaborate on technical direction through expertise, partnership, and execution.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working within Kubernetes\-based microservices environments.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Overview


We are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to join our technology team and play a key role in building, automating, and maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure technology environments.


The successful candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in **DevOps, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/OpenShift, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, automation, monitoring, and security**. The role requires someone who can work across development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams and take ownership of solutions from inception through deployment and ongoing production support.


The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in modern **cloud\-native and microservices environments**, with practical experience using tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Service Mesh, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK**.


Key Responsibilities


DevOps \& Automation* Implement and maintain DevOps practices across the software development and delivery lifecycle.
* Automate deployment, infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and operational processes.
* Develop reusable automation solutions to improve deployment speed, consistency, reliability, and scalability.
* Identify manual and repetitive operational activities and convert them into automated workflows.
* Support continuous improvement of development and operational processes.


CI/CD \& Release Management* Design, develop, implement, and maintain robust **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Build and maintain Jenkins\-based Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment pipelines.
* Develop and maintain **Jenkins Shared Libraries and Pipeline\-as\-Code** solutions.
* Develop automation scripts using **Groovy, Python, Bash**, or other appropriate scripting technologies.
* Implement and maintain **GitHub Actions** workflows for build, testing, deployment, and automation.
* Support automated application deployments across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures and deployment issues and implement permanent solutions.
* Improve release processes through automation, standardization, and continuous delivery practices.


Kubernetes \& Container Technologies* Deploy, configure, manage, and troubleshoot containerized applications.
* Work extensively with **Native Kubernetes and/or OpenShift** environments.
* Support application deployment and management across container platforms.
* Work with Kubernetes\-based workloads, services, configurations, secrets, and deployment mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot container, networking, deployment, and runtime issues.
* Support highly available and scalable containerized environments.
* Work with cloud\-native and microservices\-based architectures.


Cloud Infrastructure* Design, deploy, manage, and support infrastructure across public cloud environments.
* Work with at least one major public cloud platform such as:
* + **Microsoft Azure**
	+ **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**
	+ **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**
* Implement cloud infrastructure following security, scalability, availability, and performance best practices.
* Support cloud migration, deployment, configuration, and operational activities.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure and application\-related issues.


Infrastructure as Code \& Configuration Management* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**.
* Automate configuration management and application/infrastructure provisioning using **Ansible**.
* Create reusable and standardized infrastructure deployment processes.
* Manage multiple environments using automated and version\-controlled infrastructure configurations.
* Ensure infrastructure changes follow appropriate governance, security, and change\-management practices.


GitOps* Implement and support **GitOps\-based deployment practices**.
* Work with tools such as **ArgoCD** to automate application deployments and environment synchronization.
* Maintain deployment configurations and application manifests through version\-controlled repositories.
* Troubleshoot synchronization and deployment issues within GitOps environments.


Service Mesh \& Microservices* Provide hands\-on support for **Service Mesh technologies** in cloud\-native environments.
* Understand communication patterns between microservices and troubleshoot service\-to\-service connectivity issues.
* Support traffic management, service discovery, security, and observability within microservices environments.
* Work with authentication and authorization mechanisms for microservices.
* Support secure communication between distributed services.


Security \& Authentication* Apply strong infrastructure and application security practices across DevOps environments.
* Understand microservice **authentication and authorization** processes.
* Demonstrate knowledge of **OAuth 2\.0** standards and their practical implementation.
* Support secure API communication and service\-to\-service authentication.
* Work closely with security and infrastructure teams to identify and mitigate potential risks.
* Ensure security considerations are incorporated into CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application deployments.


Monitoring, Logging \& Observability* Implement and maintain application and infrastructure monitoring solutions.
* Work with monitoring and observability technologies such as:
* + **Prometheus**
	+ **Grafana**
	+ **ELK Stack**
* Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and monitoring mechanisms.
* Analyze logs and metrics to identify performance, availability, and reliability issues.
* Support proactive monitoring and incident detection.
* Contribute to improving system observability and operational reliability.


API \& Integration* Demonstrate understanding of **REST and SOAP APIs**.
* Work with API consumers and publishers.
* Develop or configure integrations with external and internal APIs.
* Troubleshoot API connectivity, authentication, and communication issues.
* Apply appropriate security standards when integrating APIs and microservices.


Production Support \& Troubleshooting* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, application, deployment, and environment\-related issues.
* Work closely with development and operations teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
* Participate in incident resolution and production support activities.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Support applications and infrastructure throughout their complete lifecycle.
* Maintain reliability and availability of production environments.


Project Delivery* Take ownership of technical activities from **project inception through implementation, deployment, and production support**.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, infrastructure engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to technical design and solution implementation.
* Ensure projects are delivered according to agreed timelines, quality standards, and technical requirements.
* Provide operational support after project implementation.


Required Technical Skills


The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in several of the following areas:

**DevOps \& CI/CD**

* DevOps methodology
* CI/CD
* Jenkins
* Jenkins Shared Libraries
* Pipeline\-as\-Code
* Groovy
* Python
* GitHub Actions

**Container \& Cloud Native**

* Kubernetes
* OpenShift
* Docker / Container technologies
* Service Mesh
* Microservices

**Infrastructure Automation**

* Terraform
* Ansible
* Infrastructure as Code
* Configuration Management

**Cloud**

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* OCI

**GitOps**

* ArgoCD
* Git\-based deployment practices

**Monitoring \& Logging**

* ELK
* Prometheus
* Grafana
* Application and infrastructure monitoring

**Security \& Integration**

* OAuth 2\.0
* Microservices authentication and authorization
* REST APIs
* SOAP APIs
* Infrastructure security


DevOps / SRE Knowledge


The candidate should have a comprehensive understanding of:

* DevOps principles and methodologies
* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
* Infrastructure as Code
* Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery
* GitOps
* Cloud\-native application architecture
* Microservices
* 12\-Factor Application principles
* Automation and configuration management
* Production reliability and availability
* Monitoring, logging, and observability
* Incident management and troubleshooting


Behavioral \& Professional Competencies

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues under pressure.
* Strong communication skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams.
* Strong ownership and accountability for assigned deliverables.
* Ability to manage client and stakeholder expectations effectively.
* Pragmatic and solution\-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight timelines.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to learn and adopt emerging technologies and industry best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and dynamic technology environment.


What You Will Do in This Role


This role is suited for a **hands\-on DevOps Engineer**, not someone limited to pipeline administration.


You will be expected to work across the complete DevOps lifecycle — from infrastructure provisioning and automation to CI/CD, container orchestration, cloud deployments, GitOps, monitoring, security, troubleshooting, and production support.


You will also be expected to collaborate closely with engineering and operations teams to improve **deployment efficiency, system reliability, scalability, security, and operational maturity**.

title: Platform / DevOps Engineer, Client Embedded Pod (Kubernetes / Observability / Data Infrastructure)
description:
**Experience:** 5\+ years, Mid\-Senior Level

**About** 

Langoor, A 'born in digital era' digital marketing agency is challenging/changing the very way marketers make sense of the digital disruption and navigate their way to Impact Business x Marketing x Brand Performance.

Going beyond the elementary impact of digital in terms of search, social and storytelling, marketers need to look at their customer journeys in the digital domains and focus their action based on insights of digital behaviour and contextise their marketing mix strategies and action.

Driving Indian Brands into the Digital First Marketing Era with our expertise in Data x Technology x Strategic Thinking x Creative Edge delivering agile Marketing Transformations \& Brand Performance.

**About the role**

You will join an embedded pod building the platform foundations that product and engineering teams run on, directly inside a client environment on live production systems. This is not a maintenance role. In a single quarter you could be hardening Kubernetes cluster lifecycle and capacity, tuning ClickHouse for high\-cardinality observability, and standing up or scaling Milvus for a retrieval or agent workload. The pod moves fast and the client expects production\-grade infrastructure, not one\-off scripts.

**What we expect from you**

* You write clean, production\-ready infrastructure and platform code, and you ship it fast. You do not need heavy process to move.
* You pick up unfamiliar stacks and tools quickly and without much hand holding – Kubernetes operators, GitOps, telemetry pipelines, columnar and vector databases.
* You already use modern AI tools to design, debug, and operate systems, and can show what that has done to your output.
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and switch context across infrastructure domains – cluster work one week, data\-store tuning the next – without dropping reliability.
* You can hold a technical conversation directly with a client stakeholder, not just with your own team.
* You consistently turn platform work into measurable outcomes: developer velocity, cost control, and uptime.

**Must\-have skills**

* Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle management, Helm charts and operators, capacity planning, and multi\-tenant platform design
* GitOps workflows for infrastructure and application delivery (ArgoCD, Flux, or similar)
* ClickHouse or a comparable columnar store: schema design, ingestion pipelines, and query performance tuning for high\-cardinality observability data (logs, traces, metrics, wide events)
* Vector databases in production – Milvus or similar (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) – operating data planes for retrieval and agent workloads
* Telemetry pipeline design spanning logs, traces, and metrics
* Demonstrated use of AI tools in your engineering workflow, and awareness of how to apply AI capabilities to platform operations
* Git and version control workflows in a team setting (branching, PRs, code review)

**Good\-to\-have skills**

* Writing or extending Kubernetes operators and custom controllers
* Experience with complementary observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
* Cloud platform experience – AWS, Azure, or GCP
* CI/CD pipeline ownership, not just exposure
* Cost optimization or capacity forecasting for infrastructure spend
* Exposure to building AI agents or working with LLM APIs
* Comfortable writing infrastructure tests and validation as part of your normal workflow
* Experience working in fast, iterative cycles (agile or otherwise) with shifting priorities
* Prior experience working directly embedded with a client rather than purely internal teams

**What this role is not**

* This is not a role for someone who prefers a fixed scope and stable domain. The problem domain changes – cluster hardening one week, ClickHouse tuning the next, Milvus scaling after that.
* This is not an entry\-level supervised role. You will be expected to operate independently within a few weeks of starting.

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Database DevOps Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity**

We are building a talent community for experienced database and DevOps engineers who can design, automate and support business\-critical database platforms. The role provides production and development support for database applications, establishes build and operational standards, and acts as a technical escalation point for complex database issues.


You will help design, deploy, migrate and operate Oracle and SQL database environments on Microsoft Azure. Working closely with database design, application and cloud teams, you will create robust, scalable and secure services while supporting the migration of database workloads from on\-premises environments.


**What You’ll Do (When You Join Us)**

As a Lead Database Engineer \- DevOps, you will combine deep database engineering expertise with automation, cloud and site reliability practices.


**Architect, Build and Standardise:**

Develop and maintain database build standards covering security, patching, resilience and high availability. Provide database design support to development projects and help define scalable database architectures. Design backup and recovery, clustering, data management and disaster recovery strategies. Support database connectivity through ODBC, JDBC and vendor\-specific architectures. Review database application code, collaborate on improvements and maintain source code using standard company tooling.


**Automate and Deliver:**

Develop automation for database deployment and maintenance using DevOps tooling and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for database changes and platform configuration. Implement Oracle database infrastructure in Azure and migrate workloads from on\-premises environments. Use version control, secrets management, containers and orchestration tools to improve repeatability and control. Ensure solutions align with defined database, security and compliance standards.


**Operate and Optimise:**

Monitor database resources and manage capacity to maintain optimum performance and availability. Investigate and resolve production incidents, database issues and service disruptions in a timely manner. Perform performance tuning and diagnostics using query plan analysis and Oracle tools such as AWR, ASH and ADDM. Document and execute backup, restore, upgrade, patching and disaster recovery procedures. Define a database management strategy combining documented checks, automated monitoring and actionable alerts. Maintain database infrastructure, code and integrations as a reliable service for application teams.

title: Azure DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Azure DevOps \& Cloud Infrastructure Engineer  

Experience: 5–8 Years  

Job Location: Bangalore  

Position ID: J0926\-0309  

Work Type: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Azure DevOps \& Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to architect, build, and maintain enterprise grade Azure cloud environments from the ground up. In this role, you will be the primary technical authority responsible for greenfield cloud infrastructure deployments, robust networking topologies, automated CI/CD pipelines, high availability clustering, and business continuity systems.  

  

You will design resilient systems that incorporate multi region fault tolerance, advanced Layer 4 and Layer 7 load balancing, automated container management via AKS, and strict backup/restore controls—ensuring our cloud platform is secure, scalable, and highly available.  

  

1\. Technical Stack Summary
  

  

* Cloud Platform: Microsoft Azure (Management Groups, Subscriptions, Landing Zones)
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Azure Bicep, ARM Templates
* Networking \& Load Balancing: VNet Peering, ExpressRoute, VPN, Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway (WAF), Azure Front Door, Traffic Manager, Azure Firewall, Private Endpoints
* Containers \& Orchestration: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker, Helm, NGINX / AGIC Ingress, ArgoCD / Flux
* CI/CD \& Automation: Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), GitHub Actions, Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, Python
* Backup \& Disaster Recovery: Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery (ASR), Velero
* Observability \& Security: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure Policy


  

2\. Key Responsibilities  

  

* Greenfield Cloud Infrastructure \& IaC

. Landing Zone Architecture: Architect and provision production ready enterprise Azure Landing Zones based on Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) best practices.  

. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Standardize all infrastructure deployments using modular Terraform or Bicep templates with state management and security scanning.  

. Automated Provisioning: Build end to end automated environment creation workflows (Dev, Staging, QA, Prod) with integrated parameterization and validation gates.  

  

* Advanced Networking \& Traffic Load Balancing

. Network Topology \& Isolation: Design secure Hub and Spoke network topologies, Virtual WAN (vWAN), cross region VNet peering, and strict subnet segmentation.  

. Load Balancing \& Ingress: Deploy and tune Layer 4 and Layer 7 traffic routing using Azure Load Balancer, Azure Application Gateway (WAF), Azure Front Door, and Traffic Manager.  

. SSL \& Traffic Policy: Configure SSL/TLS offloading, path based routing, health probe rules, custom WAF rules, and global latency based routing.  

. Hybrid Connectivity \& Perimeter Security: Implement secure ExpressRoute/VPN connections, Azure Firewall, User Defined Routes (UDRs), BGP routing, Private Link / Private Endpoints, and Azure Private DNS zones.  

  

* Containerization \& High Availability Clustering

. AKS Cluster Deployment: Build, scale, and maintain enterprise Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) multi tenant clusters with dedicated node pools, availability zones, and auto scaling (HPA \& Cluster Autoscaler).  

. Cluster Networking \& Service Mesh: Manage advanced CNI plugins (Azure CNI / Overlay), ingress controllers (AGIC, NGINX), and service mesh architectures for microservice routing.  

. Compute \& Database HA: Configure Virtual Machine Scale Sets (VMSS) and collaborate with DBAs to manage high availability clusters for Azure SQL Managed Instance, Cosmos DB, and Redis Enterprise.  

  

* CI/CD Pipelines \& DevOps Automation

. Pipeline Engineering: Design, implement, and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps Pipelines or GitHub Actions for application and infrastructure code.  

. GitOps \& Release Automation: Establish GitOps workflows to eliminate manual environment updates and ensure configuration drift is automatically detected and reconciled.  

. Secret \& Artifact Management: Secure pipeline credentials using Azure Key Vault, Service Connections, and Workload Identity Federation.  

  

* Backup, Restore \& Business Continuity (DR)

. Automated Backup Operations: Design and enforce centralized backup policies with Azure Backup across virtual machines, databases, stateful persistent volumes (AKS), and storage accounts.  

. Disaster Recovery (DR) Orchestration: Formulate, configure, and manage multi region Disaster Recovery plans leveraging Azure Site Recovery (ASR) to meet stringent RTO and RPO objectives.  

. Restore Drills \& Disaster Testing: Schedule and perform routine backup restore drills, cross region failovers, and failback validation procedures to ensure zero data loss during critical failures.  

  

* Security, Governance \& Monitoring

. Identity \& Governance: Apply enterprise RBAC, Azure Policy rules, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Azure Blueprints across management groups.  

. Monitoring \& Alerting: Build centralized dashboards and actionable alerting systems using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Grafana.  

  

Required Technical Experience
  

. Cloud \& Networking Mastery: 5\+ years of dedicated DevOps/Infrastructure experience, with 3\+ years specifically focused on building and managing complex Microsoft Azure environments.  

. Networking Skills: Comprehensive understanding of TCP/IP, CIDR blocks, BGP routing, DNS resolution, SSL/TLS certificates, WAF configurations, and load balancing topologies.  

. Container Orchestration: Direct experience building and operating production AKS clusters, managing ingress traffic, Helm charts, and cluster autoscaling.  

. IaC \& Scripting Expertise: Mastery of Terraform or Bicep for modular infrastructure generation, alongside proficiency in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.  

. Backup \& DR Mastery: Hands on experience configuring Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery (ASR), and performing full environment backup restore procedures.

title: Site Reliability Manager
description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience building or managing distributed systems or cloud infrastructure, with a focus on Kubernetes.
* 5 years of experience in people management.
* Experience with site reliability engineering, system design, distributed computing.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience in people management, with managing distributed, multi\-site teams through engineering managers or tech leads.
* Experience in Enterprise tooling and technology.
* Experience in Systems, Applications, and Products (SAP) or other Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

**About the job**
-----------------


Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large\-scale, massively distributed, fault\-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally\-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever\-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.


Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large\-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame\-free environment. We promote self\-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Core Enterprise System (CES) SRE is part of Corporate Engineering\-Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). We provide SRE support to Enterprise applications within Google, powering key verticals such as Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, and HR. Our mission is to deliver service excellence with engineering, innovation and customer focus and transform Google's enterprise domain.


Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large\-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage a team of 6\-10 site reliability engineers supporting Google’s enterprise services.
* Develop roadmaps, planning, objectives and key results (OKRs) to move forward the maturity of the managed services. Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement.
* Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews. Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
* Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Practice sustainable incident response ensuring services meet their service level objectives.
